body:
# Web & Mobile Outsourcing for Small Businesses in Hanoi

Cross Tech Edu is your engineering team based in Vietnam, delivering outsourced web design, mobile app and backend development for small businesses in Hanoi. Delivery in two-week sprints, 12-month code warranty, quote within 48 hours.

## Core services
- Web development: Next.js, React, Laravel — from company websites to internal multi-role systems.
- Mobile app: Flutter and React Native — one codebase for iOS and Android, we publish to the stores for you.
- Backend & API: Node, Go, .NET, PostgreSQL — REST and GraphQL, API documentation delivered.
- UI/UX design, QA / Testing, DevOps & Cloud, AI / Data, Dedicated team, Maintenance & support.

## Pricing at a glance
Dedicated developers from 300 USD per developer per month (Junior) to 1,200 USD (Senior). Fixed-price projects: company website from 39 USD, web app from 230 USD, mobile app from 1,150 USD. Detailed quote within 48 hours.

## Case study summary
Order management web app for a Hanoi food SME: handed over in 4 weeks, running on your staging from the second sprint.

## CTA
Book a free 30-minute consultation or request a detailed quote within 48 hours.

## Internal links
[See pricing](/en/pricing-sme/) · [Book a 30-minute call](#contact) · [Blog](/en/blog/)
